title: A Member who hits the Spotlight block cap sees a calm Crew panel with an equal "Keep it as it is" (Spotlight split, SPL-11)

source.ref: Spotlight split proposal §3 moment 2 (hit a cap); owner picks 2026-10-28: Crew is the personal upgrade, no new price

detail: saveMemberGridLayout keeps its error string and now also returns a typed `capReached` ({ used, allowed, crewAllowed, presetCents, suggestedCents, minCents }), read from the spotlight_blocks meter and the Crew contribute config. Both layout stores carry it and the three in-rail builders draw components/entity-blocks/spotlight-cap-panel.tsx in place of the red line: what they hit, what Crew adds, the contribute presets through the existing startMembershipCheckout and CheckoutPanel, and "Keep it as it is" as an equal choice. A Crew member at the top cap is told the fact and offered nothing to buy.

verify.note: Fails on main (no capReached signal, no panel); passes here.
